fullName: TJWA_TC_LUI_NEG_001 - [Negative] Mobile field declares its validation pattern (known enforcement gap on submit)
description:
[Negative] Verify the mobile number field declares its validation contract (pattern="[6789][0-9]{9}" — 10 digits, starting 6-9). Same shared "Contact Seller" component as the Used Harvester form, which has a confirmed gap where this pattern is not actually enforced on submit.

Expected: The field should declare the 10-digit, 6-9-prefixed pattern.
